verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents a guide to mirror a branch with another Git server. It also documents detailed GitHub sync that imports repositories and keeps code, issues and pull requests in sync one way or both. Together these cover the core of mirroring to and from another Git server. missing for 10: details of the generic branch-mirror feature beyond a docs title (direction, push vs. pull, scheduling), evidence of whole-repository mirroring with non-GitHub servers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
